meta.name: Murder in Galicia
meta.description: In Pazos, Irene is brutally attacked, and Civil Guard sergeant Elías suspects her husband Aniceto, racing against time to uncover the truth before it’s too late.

videos.title: Before Dawn
videos.overview: A distraught husband claims his wife was fatally attacked in the night. But as Sergeant Lago investigates the case, some of the evidence doesn't add up.

videos.title: Night
videos.overview: Lago digs into the couple's past. When he learns that Irene will be moved from the safety of the ICU, he's desperate to protect her from a second attack.

videos.title: Morning
videos.overview: A devastating announcement hits the headlines. But who leaked it to the press — and how did the handling of Irene Freire's case go so badly wrong?
